Title: Group differences on a five point Likert item
Text: A related question: People often use the nonparametric Mann-Whitney test for this kind of data. Since there are only five possible values, there will be lots of tied ranks. The Mann-Whitney test adjusts for tied ranks, but does this adjustment work when there are a huge number of ties?

Title: Group differences on a five point Likert item
Text: You may be interested in this recent article published in PARE, *Five-Point Likert Items: t test versus Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon*, http://j.mp/biLWrA.
